productsAndServices.description: A desktop application that allows users to run their own Iron Fish node, send, receive, and bridge assets securely.
productsAndServices.name: Iron Fish Node App

productsAndServices.description: A browser-based wallet extension for making secure and private Iron Fish transactions directly from the browser.
productsAndServices.name: OreoWallet

productsAndServices.description: A bridging service that enables encrypted transfer of assets between Iron Fish and over 20 EVM-compatible blockchains.
productsAndServices.name: Iron Fish Bi-Directional Bridge

productsAndServices.description: A command-line tool for managing Iron Fish accounts, transactions, nodes, and mining operations.
productsAndServices.name: Iron Fish CLI (Command Line Interface)

productsAndServices.description: A WebAssembly package that compiles Iron Fish cryptographic code for use in JavaScript environments like browsers and extensions.
productsAndServices.name: Iron Fish WASM Package

productsAndServices.description: A web-based tool to view and track Iron Fish blockchain transactions and blocks with limited public information due to privacy features.
productsAndServices.name: Iron Fish Block Explorer

insights.title: Funding is concentrated in the latest major round
insights.statement: The latest disclosed Series A round raised $27,600,000, or 83.89% of reported total funding.
insights.implication: This round accounts for most reported historical financing, making it important when assessing funding-source concentration and fundraising cadence.

insights.title: Valuation increased across disclosed rounds
insights.statement: Known post-money valuation rose from $37,912,060 to $186,328,066, a 4.91x increase.
insights.implication: The disclosed financing history indicates a material valuation step-up between the earliest and latest rounds with known valuations.
caveats: Only rounds with a disclosed post-money valuation are compared.

insights.title: Sharp recent attention and growth momentum
insights.statement: Crunchbase scores growth at 34 (-2 over 90 days) and market heat at 44 (-4).
insights.implication: The company has recently become much more visible, but the scores should be treated as attention/activity indicators rather than revenue or clinical-performance metrics.
caveats: Crunchbase does not expose the complete weighting behind these proprietary scores.

insights.title: Competitive benchmark reflects the modeled peer set
insights.statement: Crunchbase’s closest modeled peers include World Liberty Financial, BitGo, Chainlink.
insights.implication: These matches provide a starting point for comparing differentiation, scale, and shared specialties, but they should not be treated as a verified competitor set.
caveats: Similarity scores are algorithmic matches, not verified direct competitors.
